FAQ notes: the final battle - your enemy is the Custos that have helped you so many times before; the stage is half space and half land. Before the mission starts in earnest you choose whether to save Irui or destroy the Gun Eden: destroying it gives a different and 'worse' ending; to save her, first persuade Irui with your main character, then persuade her with any 5 main characters from series (Kouji, Hyouma, Judouu, Camille, Kinkedou, Tobia, Shingo, Banjou, etc.). Note: the FAQ's player Reinforcement Squads for this mission (Richter & Hainel on turn 3, a Reclaimer on turn 4, the 3 Dokuga Generals on turn 5, each only if you fulfilled the requirements) are ALLIED, not enemies, so they are not included in the enemy lists.
